devdoc.details: Uses the Uniswap V3 Parameters pattern: the BeaconProxy's `initialize()` call carries      no arguments — instead the SmartWallet reads owner config from the factory's transient      `_parameters` storage during its delegatecall, where msg.sender resolves to this factory.      Because `initialize()` has no arguments, the `data` passed to BeaconProxy is always      the same 4-byte selector. Combined with a fixed beacon address, wallet addresses depend      only on (factory, id) regardless of owner or coordinator changes.      Admin functions are gated by `onlyCoordinatorOwner`, which reads `owner()` from the      coordinator rather than maintaining a local owner, keeping authority centralized.

Initialized(uint8).details: Triggered when the contract has been initialized or reinitialized.

computeWalletAddress(bytes32).details: Mirrors the CREATE2 parameters used in `_deployProxy` so callers can predict the address      before spending gas on deployment.

params.walletId: The same salt that would be passed to `deployWallet` / `deployWalletWithPasskey`.

returns._0: The address the BeaconProxy would land at.

constructor.details: Disables initializers on the implementation contract so it cannot be initialized      directly. Initialization must happen atomically through the proxy's constructor.

params.wallet: EOA that becomes the wallet's sole initial owner. Does not affect the address.
params.walletId: CREATE2 salt. The wallet address is stable as long as (factory, id) is the same.

params.passkey: Passkey to register alongside the wallet owner. Algo determines which key fields are used.
params.wallet: Optional EOA that becomes an initial owner alongside the passkey; pass                address(0) to create a passkey-only wallet. Does not affect the address.
params.walletId: CREATE2 salt. The wallet address is stable as long as (factory, id) is the same.

getWallets().details: Unpaginated — may exceed RPC gas caps once the fleet grows large.      Prefer `getWalletsPage` for off-chain enumeration.

params.limit: Maximum number of entries to return.
params.offset: Zero-based index of the first wallet to include.

returns.total: Total number of deployed wallets regardless of the window.

params._coordinator: Address of the deployed SmartWalletCoordinator proxy.
params._implementation: Address of the initial SmartWallet implementation contract.

parameters().details: Only meaningful during a SmartWallet constructor delegatecall. Outside a      deployment the transient slots are empty and a zeroed struct is returned.

params.newImplementation: Address of the new SmartWallet implementation contract.

PARAMETERS_TSLOT.details: Base transient-storage slot (EIP-1153) for the abi-encoded deployment parameters.      Slot holds the blob length; data words follow in consecutive slots. Using transient      storage instead of regular storage avoids ~20k gas per word on each deployment      (the RS256 passkey path encodes to a dozen words).

__gapParameters.details: Dead storage. Previous implementations kept the deployment `Parameters` struct here      (6 slots, always `delete`d after each deployment, so the slots hold zero). The gap      preserves the slots of the wallet registry below so an already-deployed factory      proxy can be upgraded in place. Parameters now live in transient storage.

_walletIds.details: Ordered list of walletIds for enumeration in `getWallets`.

beaconImplementation.details: Owned by this factory (proxy). Call `upgradeTo` to update the implementation for all wallets.

devdoc.title: SmartWalletFactory

beaconImplementation().notice: The UpgradeableBeacon that all SmartWallet proxies point to for their implementation.

computeWalletAddress(bytes32).notice: Computes the deterministic address a wallet would be deployed to for a given walletId.

coordinator().notice: Address of the SmartWalletCoordinator. Used for admin auth and passed to wallets.

deployWallet(bytes32,address).notice: Deploys a new SmartWallet with a single EOA owner. Restricted to the relayer.

deployWalletWithPasskey(bytes32,address,.notice: Deploys a new SmartWallet with a passkey owner (ES256 or RS256) and an         optional EOA owner. Restricted to the relayer.

getWallets().notice: Returns all deployed wallets as (walletId, wallet) pairs.

getWalletsPage(uint256,uint256).notice: Returns a window of deployed wallets as (walletId, wallet) pairs.

parameters().notice: Returns the current transient deployment parameters.

upgradeTo(address).notice: Upgrades the SmartWallet implementation for all existing and future wallets.

walletIdToWallet(bytes32).notice: Maps walletId to the deployed wallet address.

walletToWalletId(address).notice: Maps wallet address back to its walletId.

userdoc.notice: Deploys SmartWallet instances at deterministic addresses using CREATE2 + BeaconProxy.         All proxies share a single UpgradeableBeacon, allowing the wallet implementation to         be upgraded for all wallets in one transaction.
